title: Get Google reviews: from 3 to 15 by 31 Dec
why: 3.7★ from only 3 reviews (one is 1★). Finnmark, #1 in the map pack, has 4.8★ from 52; Clearlight 5★ from 142; Sunlighten 4.9★ from 166.
steps: Get the review link from Google Business Profile (Ask for reviews)
Kiana gives Ruchi the contacts; Ruchi sends one client a day the review link by WhatsApp + email, mentioning their project
Reply politely to the 1★ review
Add 'ask for a review' to the handover checklist on every job
Track the count weekly on this dashboard

title: Complete the Google Business Profile
why: Only one category ('Sauna Shop'), no services, no booking link, not connected to Metricool. Finnmark lists 7 extra categories including Contractor.
steps: Add secondary categories that fit, e.g. Contractor (check Google's list for spa/sauna contractor options)
Add every range as a Service with 'from £' price ex VAT (Sana, Radiata, Cubo, Premio, Vapore…)
Add the consultation booking link
Upload case-study photos with real captions (30 photos now)
Post one GBP update a week (case study, offer, blog)
Connect GBP to the 'saunacompany' brand in Metricool

title: Confirm GA4 and conversion tracking
why: GA4 is not connected to OpenSEO, and no analytics script shows in the site's embedded apps. Without it we can't see which pages produce enquiries.
steps: Wix → Marketing Integrations → Google Analytics: check GA4 is connected
Mark key events: contact form submit, phone click, WhatsApp click
Connect the GA4 property to the OpenSEO project (Settings → Integrations)
Check Google Ads conversion import if ads are running

title: Rewrite the /sauna-installation page (money page ranks 29)
why: 2,414 impressions in 3 months but only 8 clicks; average position 29. Competitors Aqualine and Finnmark rank #1–2 for 'sauna installation'.
steps: Title: 'Sauna Installation London & UK | Bespoke, Fully Installed' (≤60 chars)
One H1 matching the title
Add prices from £8,995 ex VAT, the install process, what's included/excluded
Add 3 case studies with photos and an FAQ
Link to it from the homepage and from every blog post that mentions installation

title: Merge duplicate blog posts (they compete with each other)
why: Two 'home sauna comparison' posts (5,231 + 4,747 impressions, CTR 0.3–0.4%); two 'sauna cost' posts plus /sauna-prices; three near-identical 'London sauna services' posts.
steps: Comparison: keep 'compare and choose the best home sauna types', merge the best parts of the other, 301 redirect it
Cost: keep one cost post (merge the 4 Nov post into the March post or vice versa), 301 the other; make /sauna-prices the price list that links to it
London: merge the three 'London sauna services' posts into one, 301 the rest
Add redirects in Wix → SEO → URL Redirect Manager

title: Delete the duplicate case study page
why: /bespoke-sauna-case-studies/copy-of-garden-room-hybrid-sauna-bu is an accidental copy and Google has indexed it.
steps: Delete the 'copy of' page in the Wix editor
301 redirect it to /bespoke-sauna-case-studies/garden-room-hybrid-sauna-burlington-road-london
Request removal in Search Console if it lingers

title: Homepage title and description for more clicks
why: 42,241 impressions in 3 months with 1.75% CTR and average position 16.6: the biggest audience on the site.
steps: Title ≤60 chars with 'Bespoke Sauna Installation London' + brand
Description with a reason to click: 'from £8,995 ex VAT, free design consultation, 5-day fit-out'
Check there is exactly one H1

title: Steam room page: fix the low CTR
why: 5,476 impressions, CTR 0.68%, position 16. 'home steam room' gets 1,300 searches/month with difficulty 0 and we rank 16.
steps: Title: 'Home Steam Room Design & Installation London | Vapore'
Add the price range £14,995–£19,995 ex VAT and what drives cost
Add steam room case studies and an FAQ (waterproofing, drainage, running cost)

title: Rebuild the /bespoke-saunas-london hub page
why: 5,110 impressions but average position 41: it is the category page for every range, but too thin to rank.
steps: Short intro on ventilation and löyly (our differentiator)
One card per range with photo, 'from' price and link
Comparison table (heat-up, temperature, power, price)
Links to case studies

title: Create pages for the biggest keyword gaps
why: We have no page that targets: sauna and cold plunge (1,900/mo), basement sauna (1,000/mo, low competition), indoor sauna (1,900/mo), commercial/hotel saunas (CPC £6.39, highest-value leads), bathroom sauna (320/mo).
steps: Basement Saunas London: use the basement case studies
Commercial Saunas: hotels, gyms, health clubs, developers
Sauna + Cold Plunge: garden wellness packages
Bathroom & En-suite Saunas: small-space builds
Upgrade /luxury-outdoor-saunas for 'outdoor sauna' (9,900/mo) and /garden-sauna for 'garden sauna' (4,400/mo)

title: Blog: one keyword per post, linked to a service page
why: No posts June–October, then daily. Several posts overlap. 11 posts use '-post-ai-image' files with no alt text.
steps: Pick each new post's keyword from the Keyword gaps table; never repeat a topic
Every post links to one service page and one case study
Rename AI images and add alt text on the 11 posts
Use 4–5 categories (Guides, Costs, Case studies, Health, Design)

title: Fill the Metricool queue (0 posts scheduled)
why: Nothing scheduled for the next 30 days. Instagram did well last month (26 posts, +20 followers, 575 interactions); Facebook got 13 interactions from 14 posts.
steps: Schedule 3 posts a week on Instagram + Facebook: case-study reels, before/after, tips
Turn each blog post into a carousel
Add a LinkedIn company page for architects, developers and hotels
Review best posting times in Metricool monthly

title: Replace low-quality backlinks with relevant ones
why: 164 referring domains, but most added since May 2026 are unrelated foreign sites. Relevant links (Yell, Aqua Spazio, local press) are few.
steps: Check whether a paid link package is running; stop it if so
List the business on Houzz, Checkatrade or TrustATrader, and Bark
Ask suppliers (HUUM, Harvia, Saunum) for a dealer/installer listing
Pitch 2 case studies a quarter to local press and interiors blogs
Partner pages with architects and designers we work with

title: Area pages for London and Surrey
why: 'sauna london' gets 6,600 searches/month; we rank 21–32. The Clapham and Hampstead blog posts get 13 and 57 impressions.
steps: Build area pages with real local case studies: Kensington & Chelsea, Hampstead & North London, South-West London, Surrey
Each with its own photos, projects and a contact CTA
Link them from the footer

title: Speed up slow pages
why: 34 of 100 crawled pages took 1.5–3.3 seconds to respond (site audit, 4 Nov).
steps: Compress hero images and use WebP
Remove unused apps and fonts
Lazy-load galleries on case-study pages
Check Core Web Vitals in Search Console monthly

title: Tidy headings, FAQ schema and member pages
why: Heading levels skip on 15 pages; the FAQ page ranks 38.7; public member profile pages get crawled.
steps: Fix H1 → H2 → H3 order on case studies
Add FAQ schema to /sauna-faq and service pages
Turn off public member profiles in Wix Members settings

title: Quick wins: queries in positions 5–20
why: See the 'Close to page 1' table: e.g. 'sauna installation' 815 impressions at 7.4; 'salt sauna' 578 at 8.2; 'best home sauna uk' 547 at 10.1.
steps: Put the exact query in the page title or an H2
Add 2–3 internal links using the query as anchor text
Re-check positions after 4 weeks
